purpose: Human-review subsystem semantic candidates produced by W8E-P3 without promoting dossier-global semantics or runtime positions.
rules: Only W8E-P3 subsystemCandidates with state HUMAN_REVIEW_READY may enter review.
ACCEPT confirms only the bounded subsystem grammar/domain candidate.
ACCEPT does not promote DOSSIER-US global G16/P3.
ACCEPT does not create RP-xx, transition, threshold or projection.
REJECT leaves the subsystem candidate unadmitted and preserves evidence lineage.
Human decision must name the candidateId and reviewer role.
